# What is Koodisi?

Koodisi is an enterprise iPaaS platform — a software product by Ivoyant LLC that connects your entire stack with no-code workflow automation and built-in API management.

[Request a Demo](https://koodisi.com/request-demo) [See Comparisons](https://koodisi.com/compare)

## Koodisi is an Enterprise Integration Platform (iPaaS)

**Koodisi** connects your entire enterprise stack — CRM, ERP, HRMS, ITSM, file systems, and REST APIs — through no-code workflow automation. It is designed for organizations that need more than simple trigger-action automation: Koodisi adds governance, real-time execution tracing, API management, and AI-assisted pipeline tooling on top of core integration capabilities. Unlike lightweight automation tools, Koodisi is purpose-built for production environments where reliability, auditability, and access control are non-negotiable. Every workflow runs inside a governed workspace, every deployment goes through a structured pipeline, and every failure surfaces immediately with the context needed to resolve it fast.

## Who makes Koodisi?

Koodisi is developed and maintained by [Ivoyant LLC](https://www.ivoyant.com/), a technology-led enterprise transformation company. Koodisi is Ivoyant’s flagship integration platform product, available at [koodisi.com](https://koodisi.com/). Ivoyant brings deep enterprise integration expertise built over years of working with large organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and retail — and that experience is embedded directly into how Koodisi is designed and supported.

## What does the Koodisi platform include?

No-code workflow automation

Visual canvas to design and deploy integrations without writing code.

API management

Token-based security, client profiles, and rate limiting built in.

Agentic AI pipeline

Five AI agents — Requirements, Architect, Build, Review, Support — from intake to live troubleshooting.

Governance & change control

Approval workflows, version control, and full audit trails.

Multi-tenant workspace isolation

Public and private workspaces with role-based access control.

Real-time execution tracing

Surfaced failures, automatic retries, and one-click rollback.

80+ business-system integrations

Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, and more — plus REST, databases, files, and queues.

Environment-based deployments

Move workflows across dev, staging, and production with approval gates.

## How does Koodisi compare to other iPaaS platforms?

Most integration platforms (Zapier, n8n, Make) focus on automating individual workflows. Koodisi is built for enterprise operations teams that need governance, audit trails, multi-tenant isolation, and the ability to manage hundreds of integrations in production. See our [full comparison pages](https://koodisi.com/compare).

Koodisi vs Zapier

Zapier is great for simple consumer automations. Koodisi is built for enterprise teams that need governance, RBAC, and API management — not per-task pricing that scales unpredictably.

[See full comparison](https://koodisi.com/compare/koodisi-vs-zapier)

Koodisi vs n8n

n8n is a strong developer-first tool but leaves DevOps work to you when self-hosted. Koodisi is a fully managed iPaaS with no infrastructure to maintain.

[See full comparison](https://koodisi.com/compare/koodisi-vs-n8n)

Koodisi vs MuleSoft

MuleSoft is powerful but expensive and complex to operate. Koodisi delivers enterprise-grade integration with faster time-to-value and no specialist team required.

[See full comparison](https://koodisi.com/compare/koodisi-vs-mulesoft)

Koodisi vs Workato

Workato is recipe-based and suited to ops teams. Koodisi adds a structured Dev→Deploy→Test lifecycle and built-in API management that Workato lacks.

[See full comparison](https://koodisi.com/compare/koodisi-vs-workato)

## Who is Koodisi for?

Koodisi is designed for enterprise and mid-market organizations that need reliable, governed integration infrastructure — not just a collection of automations. It is particularly well-suited for:

- →**IT and integration teams** that manage complex cross-system workflows and need a structured deployment pipeline with change control.
- →**Operations teams** that need full visibility into running workflows and the ability to resolve failures without filing a ticket with engineering.
- →**Engineering leaders** who want to give business users self-service automation without losing control over production systems.
- →**Compliance-sensitive organizations** that require full audit trails, approval workflows, and role-based access control on every integration.

## How is Koodisi priced?

Koodisi is sold as an enterprise plan with no per-task or per-operation billing. It includes SLA-backed support, dedicated onboarding, and private workspace isolation. Plans are quoted against your deployment model and scale — see [plans](https://koodisi.com/pricing) for what each includes, or [request a demo](https://koodisi.com/request-demo) to see the platform in action.

## How do I get started with Koodisi?

Koodisi is sold as one enterprise plan, and every rollout starts with a conversation. Book a demo and we will connect your first system using one of the 80+ business-system integrations and build a workflow on the visual canvas with your team. From there, guided onboarding and a dedicated implementation team help you migrate existing integrations and get to production quickly.

If you want to see the platform first, [request a 30-minute demo](https://koodisi.com/request-demo) and we will walk you through Koodisi live, tailored to your specific use case and stack. You can also browse the [documentation](https://docs.koodisi.com/) to explore the full feature set before committing.

**Note:** “Koodisi” is also a word in the Kannada language — and that’s intentional. We chose the name because it carries meaning. This page is about **Koodisi the iPaaS platform**, available at [koodisi.com](https://koodisi.com/).

## Frequently asked questions

Still have a question? [Talk to our team](https://koodisi.com/contact).

### What is Koodisi?

Koodisi is an enterprise iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) by Ivoyant LLC. It lets organizations design, deploy, and operate automated workflows across CRM, ERP, HRMS, ITSM, and more — with no-code tooling, built-in API management, and an agentic AI pipeline.

### Is Koodisi a company or a word?

"Koodisi" is both a Kannada language word and a software brand — the name was chosen intentionally. As a brand, Koodisi refers to the enterprise iPaaS platform made by Ivoyant LLC.

### Who makes Koodisi?

Koodisi is made by Ivoyant LLC, an enterprise technology company. Koodisi is Ivoyant's flagship integration platform product.

### What does Koodisi do?

Koodisi connects enterprise systems — CRM, ERP, HRMS, ITSM, files, APIs, and more — through no-code workflow automation. It includes governance, real-time execution tracing, role-based access control, multi-tenant workspaces, and an AI-assisted agentic pipeline.

### How is Koodisi different from Zapier or n8n?

Koodisi is built for enterprise teams that need governance, audit trails, and operational control — not just automation triggers. Unlike Zapier or n8n, Koodisi includes change control with approval workflows, multi-tenant workspace isolation, API management with client profiles, and an AI-assisted pipeline from requirements to live troubleshooting.

## Ship integrations faster. Operate them without chaos.

Less time on auth, retries, and deployment scripts. More time on the integrations your customers are asking for.
